```sql
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  c.customer_type,
  SUM(oi.product_price) AS beverage_revenue
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" oi
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products" p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers" c
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE p.is_drink_item = true
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, c.customer_type
ORDER BY beverage_revenue DESC
LIMIT 500
```
